up-bitchx: the BitchX IRC client and its IRCLIB for UP-Term

Contents: bin/BitchX and lib/bx (scripts, help, translation tables).
Licence: BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSES.txt.

Needs up-term.lha installed first (version 1.0 or newer). BitchX has /UP-Term/lib/bx compiled in as
its IRCLIB, so the files install at exactly those paths in UP-Term: (bin, lib/bx, licenses). In an
UP-Term window, in vsh:
  BitchX

Install: run Install (Installer) or, with upkg, install up-bitchx. Uninstall takes the package out
again; the UP-Term Uninstall runs it first.
